source: https://releases.electronjs.org/schedule, https://releases.electronjs.org/releases.json and the versions of the electron package on npm (npm view electron versions)
policy: Electron supports its latest three stable major versions (https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/electron-timelines). Update this file at each release, before the tag: the supported majors from the schedule and the latest patch of each from npm.
note: On 2026-10-20 the schedule marks 42 as end of life and 45.0.0 as stable, but npm has no stable 45 yet (latest is 44.9.2, only 45.0.0-beta.6), and releases.electronjs.org lists 43.8.2 that npm does not carry yet. This file records what can be installed. Re-check both before tagging.
